scope: Targeted Phase 5 extraction from the official Planeswalker's Guide to Ikoria (2020-04-02), written in-universe by Vivien Reid. IKO has no episodic web fiction in the cache. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; not owner approved.

claims.subject: vivien_reid

quotes.quote: I have met many bonders on my travels and learned much from them.
May it serve you well, and may you pass it along to the next Planeswalker you meet in need of a guide. —Vivien Reid

claims.summary: Vivien Reid travelled Ikoria and wrote the guide.
claims.limitation: Vivien is the author-narrator, so this is her own account.

claims.subject: coppercoats

quotes.quote: Drannith's highly trained military is second to none at warding off monster attacks; according to the locals, its walls have never fallen since their creation.
The Drannith Defense Force, informally called the Coppercoats for their banded uniforms and polished buttons, is the most well-resourced, powerful military force in the world.
